description: Mistake catalog following MNL pattern (Mistake → Not-repeat → Learning). Used by Agent Q for priority decisions.

schema.agent: letter of agent who made or discovered the mistake

mistakes.problem: Chat input completely non-functional — users could not type, paste, or focus the input field.
mistakes.root_cause: SwiftUI TextField in NSPanel does not receive focus automatically. NSHostingView does not retain NSHostingController (weak reference caused crash). NSTextField wrapper (MacTextField) was wrong control for multi-line chat.
mistakes.fix: Replaced MacTextField with MacTextEditor (NSTextView via NSViewRepresentable). Removed weak from hostingController. Added explicit window.makeFirstResponder() in updateNSView.
mistakes.prevention: Always use NSTextView (not NSTextField) for multi-line chat. Never use weak for NSHostingController. Always call makeFirstResponder explicitly for NSPanel.

mistakes.problem: After first message timeout, all subsequent messages failed to send. Text returned to input field silently.
mistakes.root_cause: ConversationStateMachine blocked .error → .streaming transition. After timeout state stuck in .error, tryTransition(to: .streaming) returned false.
mistakes.fix: Added .error → .streaming case to canTransition(), allowing retry immediately after error.
mistakes.prevention: State machines must allow recovery transitions from error states. Always test retry paths, not just happy path.

mistakes.problem: SSE stream silently hung, causing 'The request timed out' errors on some responses.
mistakes.root_cause: AsyncSequence.bytes.lines never yielded on some SSE streams. Apple's implementation hung on certain chunk boundaries.
mistakes.fix: Replaced bytes.lines with manual Data buffer + for try await chunk in bytes, parsing complete lines from buffer.
mistakes.prevention: Do not rely on Apple's high-level AsyncSequence abstractions for protocol-critical parsing. Manual buffering is more predictable.

mistakes.problem: Command injection vulnerability — innocent messages like 'swift is great' triggered raw shell execution.
mistakes.root_cause: isLikelyCommand matched common words (swift, git, node) anywhere in text. parseIntent fell through to filesystem_bash for ANY text matching.
mistakes.fix: isLikelyCommand now only matches explicit prefixes: 'shell ', 'run ', 'exec ', '/'. parseIntent returns nil for unrecognized commands.
mistakes.prevention: Never use fuzzy matching for security-critical intent classification. Use strict prefix or explicit keyword lists.

mistakes.problem: Auto-scroll never fired for long conversations. User had to manually scroll to see new messages.
mistakes.root_cause: isNearBottom used viewport height from background GeometryReader instead of total scroll content height.
mistakes.fix: Added ScrollContentHeightPreferenceKey with GeometryReader at bottom of LazyVStack to measure actual content height.
mistakes.prevention: Always distinguish between viewport size and content size in scroll geometry. Use PreferenceKey for accurate content measurement.

mistakes.problem: A2ARegistryClient crashed under Swift 6 strict concurrency. parseSSELine called without await inside AsyncStream Task.
mistakes.root_cause: Actor-isolated mutable decoder accessed from concurrent context inside AsyncStream. Strict concurrency flagged data race.
mistakes.fix: Made parseSSELine nonisolated with local JSONDecoder instance. Added shared ISO8601DateFormatter static property.
mistakes.prevention: Under Swift 6 strict concurrency, never access actor-isolated mutable state from concurrent closures. Use nonisolated with local copies.

mnl_pattern.M: Mistake recorded. Agent Q marks task with 1 fail.
mnl_pattern.N: Not-repeat protocol applied. Fix merged. Agent Q watches for recurrence.
mnl_pattern.L: Learning extracted. Episode saved. Similar tasks get priority boost (PICK with learning).
